name: Wanderburg — Pixel 2D
description: CONVERSION TARGET, the furthest from what ships: orthographic, flat, declarative depth. Wanderburg has no sprite art at all — every mesh is built in code — so this variant documents the migration end point: the roles in GAME_SPEC.assets resolve to GENERATED placeholders until real sprites exist (`arc variant convert --source wanderburg-lowpoly3d --profile 2d --write-placeholders` materializes them). Gameplay, entity ids and the save schema are identical to every other variant. Every entity is SELF-PRESENTED (GAME_SPEC.entities declare representation "none"): js/WanderView.js + js/WanderMesh.js build the meshes on the kit engine layer, so the pipeline binds no second copy of anything.
